name: QuoteBuilder
summary: Composite for the quote flow. Lane input (origin + destination — composes Combobox) + weight input + accessorial chips + rate output (Stat) + book button. Right-rail layout: inputs left (60%), rate output + book right (40%). Mobile collapses to stacked layout.

rules: Visible focus ring required (outline + box-shadow per AGENTS.md hard rule 11).
Color is never the only signal — pair with label, shape, or icon.

dont: NEVER allow Book without a rate.
NEVER use Title Case for the rate label.
